description: SET pointer UP/DOWN BY (data-pointer arithmetic), ISO §2023:14.9.39 Format 10 - introduced 2002 (GR20 byte-granular movement; GR18 NULL -> EC-DATA-PTR-NULL; GR19: an amount that does not evaluate to an integer is a runtime EC-SIZE-ADDRESS fatal, and GR20's own arm - a resulting address outside the implementor data-pointer range (DOC-A.1-216) - is EC-RANGE-PTR with the operand unchanged, two rules with two conditions via CobolPtr.UpByAmount). LIVE (Phase-4b increment 2, DEVLOG 617): the D-U7 category re-route on the shared 85 index grammar shape - the 85 index form itself stays ungated. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 SET statement's UP BY / DOWN BY format moves index-name-3 alone ('All references to index-name-1, identifier-1, and index-name-3 apply equally to all recursions thereof', §1985:VI.6.23.3 SR1; its amount 'Identifier-3 must reference an elementary numeric integer', SR3), and 1985 has no data-pointer; the 2002 SET Format 9 (data-pointer-arithmetic) has 'Identifier-9 shall be of category data-pointer' (§2002:14.8.35.2 SR22) and 'The address contained in each identifier-9, in the order specified, is incremented, if UP is specified, or decremented, if DOWN is specified, by the number of bytes specified by arithmetic-expression-3' (§2002:14.8.35.3 GR17), and §2002:F.2 item 103 records 'Pointer data. A new class of data is introduced, a pointer type which holds data and program addresses'. 2014 keeps it (§2014:14.9.35.2 SR23; §2014:14.9.35.3 GR20).

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PAMX1.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 X PIC X(5) VALUE "HELLO".
01 P USAGE POINTER.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    SET P TO ADDRESS OF X.
    SET P UP BY 2.
    STOP RUN.
